holdout_policy: Open the real pair.csv exactly once, only through one full default pipeline run after all tests and synthetic reproducibility runs complete. Do not rerun or tune after observing it.

primary_run.primary_method_rule: Lowest mean crossed App-Inhibitor validation log-MAE among uniform, median, tuned kernel, and tuned OOD kernel
primary_run.post_holdout_policy: All analyses after opening pair.csv are descriptive only; no configuration, model, seed, feature, temperature, OOD rule, or epoch changes.

synthetic_reproducibility_run.data: Deterministically generated synthetic CSVs under audit_outputs only
